title: shadPS4 0.11.0: official development build
summary: shadPS4 published 0.11.0 on September 18, 2025. The release record documents an official development build for the PlayStation 4 emulator project.

blocks.text: The shadPS4 project published version 0.11.0 on September 18, 2025. GitHub marks this entry as a release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.
The official notes highlight the following changes: mmap executable memory. Zero top bits in INSERTQ/EXTRQ. Fix read-only file unmaps on Windows. Standardize RegisterLib names for HLE libraries.
